    StartersMosasaur feeding prawnsGarlic chilli lime butter prawns grilled and piled on a platterHow to make it600g green prawns, peeled3 garlic cloves, crushed2 red chillies, chopped3 limes, one zested and the rest in wedges60g butter, meltedToss the prawns with the garlic, red chillies, lime zest and melted butter.Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred.Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.Gyrosphere cheese ballsCream cheese and cheddar balls rolled in chopped walnuts and smoked paprikaHow to make it200g cheddar, grated250g cream cheese2 tbsp snipped chives100g walnuts, finely chopped1 tbsp smoked paprika1 box water crackersMix the cheddar, cream cheese and chives. Roll into small balls.Coat in the walnuts mixed with the paprika.Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers.Main Street cinnamon sugar pretzelsKnots baked chewy, buttered and rolled in sweet spice, caramel dipHow to make it500g plain flour7g dried yeast1 tsp salt320ml warm water4 tbsp bicarb soda60g butter, melted115g caster sugar (1 tbsp for the dough)2 tsp ground cinnamon1 jar caramel sauce, warmedMix the flour, yeast, salt, 1 tbsp sugar and warm water into a dough and knead for 8 minutes.Cover and rest for 1 hour until puffy.Heat the oven to 220°C. Roll the dough into 8 ropes and twist each into a pretzel knot.Boil 2L water with the bicarb soda and dip each knot for 30 seconds, then lift onto a lined tray.Bake for 12 minutes until deep brown.Brush with the melted butter, toss in the rest of the sugar mixed with the cinnamon and serve with warm caramel sauce.Popcorn chicken with ranchBite-size chicken in crisp seasoned crumbs, with cold ranch for dippingHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsOwen's smoky beef short ribsPaprika and pepper rubbed, slow cooked off the bone, sticky glaze, cornHow to make it2kg beef short ribs2 tbsp smoked paprika1 tbsp cracked black pepper1 tbsp brown sugar2 tsp salt200ml barbecue sauce4 corn cobs50g butter1/2 cabbage, shredded1 carrot, grated4 tbsp mayonnaise1 tbsp white vinegarHeat the oven to 140°C. Rub the short ribs all over with the smoked paprika, pepper, brown sugar and salt.Wrap tightly in foil and cook for 5 hours until the meat pulls off the bone.Turn the oven up to 220°C, unwrap, brush with the barbecue sauce and roast for 15 minutes until sticky.Boil the corn for 6 minutes and butter it.Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and vinegar for slaw and serve with the ribs and corn.Isla Nublar fish tacosChilli cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbageHow to make it600g flathead fillets1 tsp chilli powder1 tsp ground cumin1 tsp salt2 tbsp oil1/2 pineapple, diced1/4 red onion, finely diced3 limes300ml sour cream8 corn tortillas1/4 small cabbage, shreddedDice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.Dust the flathead fillets in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry in the oil until just cooked. Flake into pieces.Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.SweetsDino egg chocolate mousseDark chocolate mousse in glasses, biscuit soil, speckled choc egg on topHow to make it200g dark chocolate300ml thickened cream3 eggs, separated4 chocolate biscuits, crushed8 speckled chocolate eggsMelt the chocolate and cool slightly.Whip the cream and whisk the egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites.Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 hours.Top with crushed biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.DrinksTheme park frozen lemonadeFresh lemonade blended with ice till slushy, in big souvenir cupsHow to make it6 lemons, juiced150g caster sugar500ml water1 bag iceDissolve the sugar in the lemon juice and water.Freeze in a tray for 2 hours.Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws.Frozen margaritaTequila, lime and orange liqueur blended with ice, salt on the rimHow to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
